_note: SYNTHETIC medical history for the five fictional crew members of the demo mission. Not real people, not clinical data. Hand-written for the demo; some items tie into the simulated events (John's infection, Maria's sleep).

family_history: Father: high blood pressure from age 55
genetic: Higher than average predisposition to high blood pressure (polygenic score)
kenji.notes: Long-duration flight experience. Tracks blood pressure closely because of family history.

john.notes: Penicillin allergy matters for any infection treatment onboard.

genetic: Higher than average predisposition to low bone density
stefan.notes: Bone loss in low gravity is the main thing to watch. Keep resistance training daily.

amara.notes: Crew medical officer. Uses latex-free gloves from the medical kit.

conditions: Episodes of insomnia during stressful periods
genetic: Evening chronotype (naturally sleeps and wakes later)
maria.notes: Sleep is the early sign to watch. Protect her sleep window during busy weeks.
